C0813.title: Zscaler Suffers Data Theft via Third-Party Platform Supply Chain Attack
C0813.summary: Zscaler disclosed that in August 2025 it became aware of a campaign targeting the Salesloft Drift marketing SaaS platform and affecting many customers. Attackers stole OAuth tokens connected to Salesloft Drift and gained limited access to some Zscaler Salesforce information, including business contact details, product licensing and commercial information, and selected support case header fields. Zscaler said the incident was confined to the Salesloft Drift app and did not involve its products, services, or underlying systems.
